compact_codec.insertion: replace with zero-width editable byte range

fixture_bank.evidence_type: deliberately synthetic trajectories, never human feedback
fixture_bank.split_group: Whole semantic task family across all languages, seeds and lexical variants; additionally group repository/session/commit ancestry where applicable.

future_synthetic_proposal.goal: Verify history-conditioned next-action mechanics and latest-intent propagation before claiming broad editor usefulness.
future_synthetic_proposal.no_edit_policy: Only explicit terminal synthetic states with all declared dependency checks satisfied, or regions outside a defined task scope with a stated objective. No label from arbitrary inactivity, navigation, cancellation, shadow output or an unshown proposal.
quality_limits: Mechanical replay/exact action success does not establish human next-edit quality.
Separate semantic edit-required and no-edit denominators, latest-intent reversals, unnecessary edits, coverage and EOS termination.
Check history ablations and contrast pairs so a model cannot win through fixed header/template memorization.
Do not extend reserved benchmarks or old test groups into training.

rename_example.contradictions: Counterexamples include choosing value3 directly, reversing3->2, changing an unrelated numeric literal, and moving to an unrelated region. Preserve latest actual edit; earlier mappings are not permanent goals.
rename_example.history: Declaration changes value0 -> value1, then value1 -> value2, then value2 -> value3 in explicitly recorded states.
rename_example.stop: Once all corresponding references match latest declaration, no edit. Do not predict a future value4 without new visible intent.
rename_example.target: Replace a selected remaining reference with the latest currently declared name.

required_fields: deterministically selected region from current cursor/state
ordered recent edits and anchors sufficient for reconstruction
